claim.subject: US metros, 2025 FHA forward loans
claim.definition: Within each metro with both types present, mean observed denial rate of lenders operating in 40+ metros minus mean of lenders operating in fewer than 40 metros; lenders with >=100 decisioned applications in the metro

use_boundary: Footprint is a proxy for scale, not a legal or corporate classification.
Differences are consistent with applicant mix, channel (wholesale/correspondent vs retail) and product composition, not only lender standards.
Local lenders show the widest dispersion: the softest and the strictest doors in the record are both narrow-footprint lenders.
does_not_establish: That local lenders treat identical applicants more favorably
